code:
RPO   Recovery Point Objective
      how much DATA LOSS is acceptable
      -> gap between protection points

RTO   Recovery Time Objective
      how much DOWNTIME is acceptable
      -> speed of the recovery process itself
caption: Independent numbers — a system can be tight on one, loose on the other.
